"""真实平台文件只读复核；所有模拟旧缓存仅写临时目录。"""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import fetch_gmyhf_testdata as fetch
import repair_gmyhf_pending_answers as common
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
session=fetch.session();url=fetch.oj_submit.HOST+'/admin/download?problem_id=30497&filename=0.out'
page_url=fetch.oj_submit.HOST+'/admin/problems/edit/?id=30497'
before=session._get(page_url)
with session._opener.open(session._request(url),timeout=60) as response:
 payload=response.read();length=response.headers.get('Content-Length')
assert payload and payload!=b'X'*len(payload)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gmyhf-fetch-resume-') as temporary:
 folder=Path(temporary);target=folder/'0.out';target.write_bytes(b'X'*len(payload))
 changed=fetch.download_one(30497,folder,'0.out',False)
 assert target.read_bytes()==payload and changed['sha256']==sha(payload) and not changed.get('skipped')
 os.utime(target,ns=(10**9,10**9));mtime=target.stat().st_mtime_ns
 same=fetch.download_one(30497,folder,'0.out',False)
 assert same['skipped'] and target.stat().st_mtime_ns==mtime
 forced=fetch.download_one(30497,folder,'0.out',True)
 assert not forced.get('skipped') and target.read_bytes()==payload and target.stat().st_mtime_ns!=mtime
 assert all(r['bytes']==len(payload) and r['sha256']==sha(payload) for r in (changed,same,forced))
after=session._get(page_url);assert common.form_sha(before)==common.form_sha(after)
report={'task':'T-060','batch':27,'baseline':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'problem':30497,'filename':'0.out','remote_bytes':len(payload),'remote_sha256':sha(payload),'remote_content_length':length,'changed_equal_length_cache':changed,'identical_body_cache':same,'force_same_body':forced,'unchanged_cache_mtime_preserved':True,'platform_form_unchanged':True,'platform_writes':0,'raw_snapshot_modified':False,'sources_sha256':{str(path.relative_to(root)):sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in (root/'scripts/fetch_gmyhf_testdata.py',root/'tests/test_fetch_gmyhf_testdata.py')},'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'procedure_sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())}
(root/'collab/gmyhf-fetch-resume-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('真实平台回读通过：等长旧缓存已更新，相同正文保留mtime，force重写；平台和原始快照零改动')
